M1 floating button: show, drag, edge snap, tap handling, position memory, permission flow.

M2 persistent capture: one consent, continuous frames, grab the current frame on tap.

M3 solving pipeline: drag-to-select, crop and compress, DeepSeek vision call, answer card (question echo, steps, confidence).

M4 polish: streaming thinking output, on-device OCR channel (full build), encrypted API key, custom prompt, local history with question images.

M5 follow-ups: ask again inside the answer card with context kept; LaTeX rendered natively.

Next: continue a conversation from history, and a one-shot capture mode that uses less data.
